title: Disliking bop trumpet tone; old-fashioned trombone vibrato
summary: Clayton dislikes the dead bop trumpet tone, and they joke about the trombonists in Benny Carter's Newport band.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing

blocks.x: Well what did, now what, how did you feel about the sort of changes in trumpet style and sound that bop brought about with you know, with reference to vibrato and tempo?

Oh I didn't like it, I still don't. I mean that's just not my kind of way a trumpet should sound. Maybe today it might be, but not to me. And I still don't like the dead tone, a dead tone, flat. A dead tone. I admire the technique of some of the guys. I admire their technique, but I never did care too much for that hollow dead trumpet tone. And still I don't like too much by (B ?) either.

Well not when it gets sort of sort of sound. But, no everything needs to be in balance. But somebody was talking to me in that Benny Carter band at the Newport Festival and they said that, they said some of the guys in the trombone section were playing with that old-fashioned vibrato. He said, we don't play play that way any more. You can't go that way.
Who was in the trombone section?
Well we don't have to go into

that /but this was interesting to me you know, because they'd all four come out of that same period. There was Tyree, Benny Morton and Dickie. So you know, they were saying well, they've been playing with that old style for vibrato . You can't do that any more. Which I thought was rather funny.
(LAUGHTER).
I don't know who said it.
Well you'd have to think.
But I can imagine.
Yes, well you'll see there's .......(LAUGHTER).
I could tell you three of them that it wasn't, so it has got to be one of them.
Well this was very interesting to me since they are, you know, all out of the same period.
Sure they are. And they are all, they all got vibrato ..........
So one of them has sort of conformed to the contemporary use and the other three have sort of stayed by what they .......
That's exactly the one I'm thinking about. I know who you are talking about.
It is rather funny though. I'm standing there and I'm having to say, well yes I can see where it's difficult . (LAUGHTER).
Well if they wanted it in that kind of band they wouldn't have had Benny Carter there.
No.
You see if they want that kind of band they've got to, well I won't even say that, whose band.
That's right. I mean they were supposed to illustrate a point, the values of the so-called swing era.
I bet the guy who said that must be about 65 years old. He got to be older than I am. (LAUGHTER). I know who you are talking about. Because I definitely know three of them that didn't say it.
